A MoonBit app has a module, an executable package, and a QuickGUI configuration. Bun runs development tooling; the packaged app is a native executable.

## Generated files

```text
my-app/
  main/
    main.mbt
    moon.pkg
  moon.mod
  quickgui.toml
  package.json
```

`moon.mod` declares the application module and SDK dependency. `main/moon.pkg` imports the packages used by the executable:

```moonbit
import {
  "egoist/quickgui/ui",
  "egoist/quickgui/native",
  "egoist/quickgui/reactive",
}

pkgtype(kind: "executable")
```

## Local development

Until the SDK is published, create `moon.work` in a parent directory containing both your app and the QuickGUI checkout. Paths are relative to that workspace:

```toml
members = ["quickgui/moonbit", "my-app"]
```

From `quickgui`, run `bun packages/cli/src/cli.ts dev --project ../my-app`. This uses the local CLI without installing a published package.

## Configuration

```toml
name = "My App"
identifier = "com.example.myapp"
frontend = "moonbit"
entry = "main"

[native]
extensions = []
```

`frontend` selects MoonBit; omitting it selects Go. `entry` names the executable package directory. Add extension directories containing `quickgui.extension.json` to `native.extensions`. `quickgui build` packages the executable, selected native libraries, fonts, and configured resources. `.quickgui` holds development output and caches; do not commit it.

## Packages

| Package | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `egoist/quickgui/ui` | Fluent elements, styles, bindings, lists, tables, and splitters. |
| `egoist/quickgui/reactive` | Signals, memos, effects, batching, and cleanup. |
| `egoist/quickgui/native` | Windows, events, dialogs, menus, services, and extensions. |
| `egoist/quickgui/protocol` | Core property constants and mutation value types. |
